name: com.tryplayloop/playloop
title: Playloop
description: Make group quiz games: create and edit quizzes, invite friends to add questions, reuse rounds.

tools.name: get_authoring_context
tools.description: Use first when making a quiz or game. Get supported formats, defaults, account hosting limits and access, and what people do only in Playloop. create_quiz creates a lobby; promise invitation links only when the result contains them.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: Use when the user wants to find, edit, reuse or replay a game they hosted earlier. Returns their own games newest first, with player counts and replayEditionId when a finished game can be played again exactly; get_quiz retrieves the full content.

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.description: Use before editing or reusing an owned game, or to check who has joined its lobby and is ready. Returns the prepared-content revision, rounds, question count, validation issues, links, and each joined player with readiness and how many questions they submitted. Replay definitions read the frozen edition: prepared rounds include questions; private contribution rounds expose only positions and counts with contentHidden true. Never returns other players' contribution content or gameplay.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.

tools.name: create_quiz
tools.description: Use for requests to make a quiz or game for friends, or to reuse an earlier quiz as a new game. Supply complete rounds, questions and answers. Creates a real editable lobby and returns host and invitation links. Free access and no contributions are defaults. Use paid single-edition access only with user authorization. Retry identical input with the same requestId, including after timeouts; never create a replacement quiz. Never starts gameplay. Summarize without revealing answers; follow-up edits target the returned runId.

nickname.description: Host player name. Use Host when no name was supplied.

access.description: Free access by default. Select an owned paid grant only with the user’s authorization; single-edition access is bound to the new game.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

tools.name: update_quiz
tools.description: Use for follow-up edits after get_quiz. Updates the game at expectedRevision while it is still an editable lobby. Keep stable question/round IDs. Accepts title, blocks and partial settings; omitted fields are preserved. Set contributions to optional with questionsPerContributor for a requested per-person maximum, or disabled to close submissions while retaining existing content. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.

expectedRevision.description: Use the prepared-content revision returned by get_quiz.

tools.name: replay_game
tools.description: Use when the user wants to play a finished game again with exactly the same questions. Pass replayEditionId from list_quizzes. Creates a new lobby with a fresh invitation; a rematch cannot be edited (use create_quiz with the old rounds for an edited version). Never starts play. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

nickname.description: Host player name. Use Host when no name was supplied.

tools.name: refresh_invitation
tools.description: Use when the user wants a fresh invitation for an existing editable lobby. Previous invitation links stop admitting new players. Returns the replacement link and expiry. Does not start play. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.

tools.name: cancel_lobby
tools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel a lobby that has not started. Its invitation stops working and nobody can play it. A game in progress is stopped in Playloop instead. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.
